title: THIRTY-TWO
text: THIRTY-TWO D ID you think the story was finished? That the fourth installment of the Vampire Chronicles had come to a close? Well, the book should be ended. It really should have ended when I lit that small candle, but it didn’t. I realized that the following night when I first opened my eyes. Pray continue to Chapter Thirty-three to discover what happened next. Or you can quit now, if you like. You may come to wish that you had.
